title: Truchas 2D thermal preconditioner
description: Preconditioner settings for the implicit thermal solve. The method selects either SSOR or BoomerAMG; the selected method reads its settings from the required params object.

method.description: Preconditioning method. The value is case-insensitive; supported values are SSOR, BoomerAMG, and Boomer. The default is BoomerAMG.

params.description: Settings for the selected preconditioner. This object is required even when all of its optional settings use defaults.

num-cycles.description: Number of forward/backward SSOR sweeps applied by the preconditioner. The default is one.

omega.description: Over-relaxation factor for the SSOR sweeps. The default is 1.0.

boomeramg-params.title: BoomerAMG parameters
boomeramg-params.description: Settings passed to the BoomerAMG preconditioner. The defaults are the values used by the 2D implementation.

num-cycles.description: Number of AMG cycles applied by the preconditioner. This value is required.

print-level.description: AMG diagnostic output level: 0 for no output, 1 for setup information, 2 for solve information, or 3 for both.

debug-level.description: AMG debugging level. Zero disables debugging; the default is zero.

logging-level.description: AMG residual logging level. Zero disables logging; the default is zero.

coarsen-type.description: BoomerAMG coarsening method selector. The default is 10.

strong-threshold.description: Strength threshold used when forming the AMG hierarchy. The default is 0.5.

interp-type.description: BoomerAMG interpolation method selector. The default is 6.

relax-down-type.description: Relaxation method selector for AMG down cycles. The default is 13.

relax-up-type.description: Relaxation method selector for AMG up cycles. The default is 14.
